report.disclaimer: Nguon cong khai. Cuoi tuan 26/9 ICT, HOSE dong cua. So lieu phien 25/9 va dong cua My 25/9.

globalNews.title: Pho Wall tang cuoi tuan khi dau giam nho ky vong Hormuz
globalNews.summary: S&P 500 +0,51% len 7743,41; Nasdaq 100 +0,42%; Dow +0,93% len 51828,62. Dau ha khi co tin Iran de xuat mo Hormuz.

impact.text: Chung khoan My hoi; rui ro nang luong ha nhiet ngan han nhung loi suat van cao.

globalNews.title: Dau rut, vang giu gan 4320 USD giua ky vong Fed
globalNews.summary: WTI quanh 92,5 USD (-2,3%). Vang COMEX 4320,5 USD (+0,52%) nhung ca tuan van yeu vi loi suat.

impact.text: Gia dau giam ho tro lam phat; vang van nhay voi loi suat.

globalNews.title: Loi suat My lap dinh nhieu nam, rui ro rut von chau A
globalNews.summary: Trai phieu My ban thao: 10Y cao nhat tu 2007, 30Y cao nhat tu 2004. Chenh lech voi trai phieu chau A noi rong.

impact.text: Loi suat cao la luc can dong von ngoai vao thi truong moi noi.

globalNews.title: Thuong dinh Trump-Tap: it thoa thuan, noi ve Iran va AI
globalNews.summary: Ong Trump noi da ban chien su Iran voi ong Tap. My-Trung gia han dinh chien thuong mai them 2 thang.

impact.text: Giam rui ro thue ngan han; AI va ban dan van la diem nghe.

globalNews.title: Chung khoan chau Au tang tuan dau tien sau 4 tuan
globalNews.summary: Stoxx 600 huong +0,8% ca tuan khi dau ha. FTSE 100 dong cua 10695,25 (+0,14%).

impact.text: Au huong loi khi gia nang luong ha nhiet.

globalNews.title: Nikkei tang 1,3% len 66364; Hang Seng giam 1%

impact.text: A phan hoa: Nhat manh, Hong Kong yeu.

globalNews.title: Bitcoin lui ve gan 83900 USD cuoi tuan
globalNews.summary: BTC-USD khoang 83928 USD (-0,8%); ETH 2689 USD di ngang.

impact.text: Bien dong crypto han che khi lai suat thuc My con cao.

globalNews.title: DXY lui 101,01; hang hoa phan hoa sau phien My

impact.text: USD hoi yeu giup vang; dau giam giam ap luc lam phat.

vietnamNews.title: VN-Index tang 10 diem phien cuoi tuan, thanh khoan van mong
vietnamNews.summary: Chot 25/9, VN-Index 1785,11 (+10,02; +0,56%). Khop lenh HoSE ~11600 ty; tong GTGD ~15278 ty.

impact.text: Hoi ky thuat sau 2 phien roi, nhung thanh khoan yeu giam do tin cay.

vietnamNews.title: Ho Vin keo chi so: VHM +5,66%, VIC +0,87%
vietnamNews.summary: VHM, VPL, VRE, VIC dan dat phuc hoi. HNX-Index 272,21 (-0,56 diem). HoSE 188 ma giam / 149 ma tang.

impact.text: Da tang phu thuoc tru Vin; do rong chua xac nhan uptrend.

vietnamNews.title: Khoi ngoai ban rong 254 ty HoSE, gom SBT gan 247 ty
vietnamNews.summary: Ngoai ban rong HoSE 254 ty, HNX 2,23 ty. Mua SBT 247 ty, BSR 108. Ban TCB 115, VIC 78.

impact.text: Ban rong ha nhiet so voi 23-24/9 nhung chuoi rut von chua dao.

vietnamNews.title: Lai suat qua dem lien ngan hang ha con khoang 1%
vietnamNews.summary: ON VND xuong ~1%/nam ngay 24/9 tu 7% ngay 21/9. NHNN hut rong hon 4500 ty qua OMO.

impact.text: Thanh khoan he thong doi dao ngan han; chua dong nghia noi long chinh sach.

vietnamNews.title: Xang E10 len 27087 dong/lit, khong trich Quy BOG

impact.text: Gia xang cao cong ap luc CPI nhung thang cuoi nam.

vietnamNews.title: PNJ ha ke hoach, kich ban du phong lo 6270 ty, cat co tuc
vietnamNews.summary: Doanh thu 2026 ha con 39057 ty. LNST base 800 ty; neu du phong ton that thi lo 6270 ty.

impact.text: Tin tieu cuc nganh vang trang suc; anh huong tam ly blue-chip ban le.

vietnamNews.title: VCBS: BSR lai Q3 co the +446%; nhom chung khoan suy giam
vietnamNews.summary: Du bao 54 DN: BSR +446%, VHM +243%, PVT +133%, MSN +121%. Ba CTCK trong mau co the giam lai Q3.

impact.text: Ky vong KQKD phan hoa manh; dau khi/BDS sang hon CK.

vietnamNews.title: Nhip 24/9: hon 400 ma do, VN-Index mat 26,6 diem
vietnamNews.summary: Phien 24/9 VN-Index 1775 (-1,48%), 433 ma giam HoSE. Ho Vin lay ~15 diem.

impact.text: Day 24/9 quanh 1770 van la moc can giu sang tuan sau.

outlook.summary: HOSE dong. VN-Index 1785,11 sau nhip hoi mong. Ngoai van ban. Pho Wall xanh khi dau giam; loi suat My con cao.

Hoi diem ma GTGD thap de bi cung chan o 1800.
